lines.text: Moses recites all the words of the song to all Israel with Joshua son of Nun.
Moses tells Israel to take his words to heart and teach their children the law, for it is their life.
That day the LORD tells Moses to go up Mount Sinai, across from Jericho, and view Canaan.
Moses will die on the mountain as his brother Aaron died on Mount Hor, because both broke faith at Meribah-kadesh.
They broke faith in the Wilderness of Paran, so Moses will see the land but not enter it.
